pixelDefinitions.highLuminance: Linear sRGB relative luminance >= 0.5; only pixels inside the visible CSS canvas.
pixelDefinitions.brightSaturated: max(R,G,B) >= 192 and HSV saturation >= 0.3; only pixels inside the visible CSS canvas.
pixelDefinitions.canvasChanged: Within the complete canvas screenshots at matched viewport/time, max absolute channel difference score0->555 >= 32.
pixelDefinitions.canvasBrighter: Within the complete canvas screenshots at matched viewport/time, linear sRGB luminance(score555)-luminance(score0) >= 0.1.
pixelDefinitions.limitation: Static coverage proxies; they do not identify every glowing shader pixel or establish flashing safety.
